source_caption_text:
Following Reggie’s announcement that he’s officially stepping away from the Clover Boys, #Tota has now shared his reaction — making it clear that the situation isn’t sitting lightly with him.

Tota reminded Reggie that the group is more than just a crew, saying that everyone is like a brother to him. While he understands that people have their own decisions to make, his message suggests that walking away when things get difficult isn’t the way he believes family should handle tough times.

With emotions clearly running high, Tota appears to be questioning Reggie’s decision to leave and urging him not to give up on the people who have been beside him.
